**SECTION D: COMPOSITION (10 MARKS)**

*Write a composition of between 200 to 250 words on ONE of the following topics.*

**Topic 1**

You are the president of the health club of your school. Recently many youths have suffered from Corona Virus. Write a speech sensitising your school mates about corona virus. The speech is to be presented during the youth week celebration. In your speech, explain what the Corona Virus is; Give the different means of transmission, symptoms and how it can be prevented. Explain what you will do if you are sick of the Corona Virus. Your name is Ojong Eric and your school is GBHS Tatum.

questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Un discours (*speech*) s'adresse directement à un auditoire présent : il s'ouvre par une formule d'adresse (*Good morning everyone*, *Dear schoolmates*), se referme par une formule de clôture (*Thank you for listening*), et emploie tout au long le tutoiement collectif (*you*, *we*) pour interpeller l'auditoire, à la différence d'un essai ou d'une lettre qui s'adressent à un destinataire absent.

Le sujet impose ici cinq contenus obligatoires à traiter dans l'ordre indiqué par la consigne : définition du virus, modes de transmission, symptômes, moyens de prévention, conduite à tenir en cas d'infection. Omettre l'un de ces cinq points fait perdre des points de contenu, indépendamment de la qualité de la langue.

### Corrigé détaillé - discours modèle
**Good morning teachers and dear schoolmates,**

My name is Ojong Eric, president of the health club of GBHS Tatum. On this youth week celebration, I stand before you to talk about a disease that has affected many young people around us: the Corona Virus.

The Corona Virus, or COVID-19, is an infectious disease caused by a virus that attacks the respiratory system. It spreads mainly through droplets released when an infected person coughs, sneezes or talks, and also through touching contaminated surfaces before touching one's face.

The common symptoms include fever, dry cough, tiredness, loss of taste or smell, and difficulty breathing in severe cases. Some people show no symptoms at all but can still spread the virus to others.

To prevent this disease, we must wash our hands regularly with soap, wear a face mask in crowded places, keep a reasonable distance from others, and avoid touching our eyes, nose and mouth with unwashed hands. Getting vaccinated is also strongly recommended.

If I ever fell sick with the Corona Virus, I would immediately isolate myself from others, inform my parents and the school authorities, and seek medical attention at the nearest health centre rather than hiding my condition or self-medicating.

Dear schoolmates, this disease is dangerous, but it is not unbeatable. Let us protect ourselves and protect one another by following these simple measures every single day.

**Thank you for listening.**

### Piège à éviter
N'oublie jamais la formule d'adresse initiale et la formule de clôture : un texte qui traite parfaitement les cinq contenus attendus mais qui ressemble à un essai plutôt qu'à un discours perd des points de forme, séparés des points de contenu au barème.

### Conseil
Compte tes mots par paragraphe pendant la rédaction plutôt qu'à la fin seulement : viser environ 35 à 45 mots par paragraphe sur les six paragraphes de ce modèle permet de rester naturellement dans la fourchette 200-250 mots sans avoir à couper du contenu au dernier moment.
